title_navigation: What to expect on these pages ?
p_intro: A welcome you into my small, humble and eclectic domain on the internet. These modest pages form my virtual showcase. You will find informations about my research works as well as diverse resources linked to my teaching activity.
p_short_bio_1: I am a doctor of computer science, graduate from the University of Strasbourg. I have been educated in computer science and more precisely in medical image processing (histology) and in mathematical morphology. I prepared and defended a thesis titled Multi-scale hierarchical structures for histological image analysis in 2024. Please visit the CV page for more details.
p_short_bio_2: I worked for the Cancéropôle Est (2019-2020) then at the ICube UMR 7357 laboratory (2020-2026) in the SDC : Data Science and Knowledge. My research works are focused on developing morphological methods for histological image analysis used to diagnose cases of pancreatic cancers.
p_short_bio_3: I teached at the IUT Robert Schuman in Illkirch-Graffenstaden from 2020 to 2026 where I mainly teached about the basis of algorithmics, imperative programming (in C, C# and Python), the basis of UML modelling and object-oriented programming (in Java), databases and the SQL language as well as some applied mathematics (analysis and statistics).
p_navigation_1: Concerning my research works, I invite you to visit the pages Research describing my research projects and Publications listing my published scientific articles with associated resources. You will find various amount of resources including the articles themselves as well as conference posters, conference powerpoint presentations and more explanations.
p_navigation_2: The Teaching page describes the various teaching units I took part of along the years. Each teaching unit has a dedicated page containing the specific resources of that unit. You will find solutions for exercices and exams (algorithms and/or codes) and some projects realised alongside the students.
p_navigation_3: The Projets page contains aditional codes that I made over the years in different contexts. The Talks page describes various events where I took part and made a speech. It includes public presentations like speeches at conferences, thesis defense or vulgarisation activities...
